description: Changes the business templates: bookable services (booking sets, rules, price in credits or money), credit kinds and what tops them up, standing places. Day to day (sessions, bookings, balances, applications): neblla_booking, neblla_credits, neblla_business. Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users).

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

business.description: The whole object { booking, credits, standing, … } (replaces it); null clears it. Shapes in the guide section.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_update_app_business
title: Change business templates
